name: How long does a typical electrical fixture installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical electrical fixture installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an electrical fixture installation depends on the complexity of the job, the number of fixtures, and whether new wiring or structural modifications are required. A simple replacement might take an hour, while a multi-fixture installation with new wiring could take several hours or even a full day. We provide an estimated timeline during our initial consultation once we understand the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by complexity, number of fixtures, and new wiring needs; simple replacements are quicker, while larger jobs take longer.
